capabilities: list open panes in a sidebar vertical-tabs view
switch to any pane with one click
pin or unpin panes so new notes open in their own pane
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not manage saved workspace layouts; it manages currently open panes with a vertical-tabs view and pinning.
extras: README lists planned features (pane switcher modal, pane arrangements) and states no known issues; references a screen recording not present in text.
intentEvidence: an obsidian plugin to enhance the workspace
problem: In modes like sliding panes or maximized active pane, open panes are hidden and hard to reach, and new notes can overwrite an unpinned pane's note.

relations.evidence: works a little like vertical tabs (in vivaldi and edge browsers)

summary: Adds a sidebar tab listing all open panes as vertical tabs, plus pin/unpin controls to keep panes from being reused.
